facts.fact: WHO reports Germany, through WHO, donated 95 laptops and 130 scanners worth USD 222,594 to Uganda's Ministry of Health on 19 September 2024 for the EMR scale-up, for the National Referral Hospital, selected regional referrals and general hospitals.

Permanent Secretary Diana Atwine said the Ministry of Health is rolling out a comprehensive EMR system in phases to all health facilities, starting with national referral hospitals down to high-volume health centre IIIs.
WHO says the Ministry of Health is digitising health service delivery in line with its Health Information and Digital Health Strategic Plan 2020/21-2024/25.
